_about: Advisor evaluation set. Expected values were pulled live from the official services on 2026-11-16 (workers/sources.ts). Law and funding questions are answered from the audited tables (workers/localData.ts). Trap questions have no sourced answer; the advisor passes only by saying so. Capitol-address questions cover 44 states and DC (addresses validated by the Census Geocoder; 7 states dropped where the geocoder matched a different address or none). Run: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... npm run eval:advisor
